body:
The fix is correct. It's concerning that with the design of `AHashMap`, that this sort of bug is so easy to trigger and produces a difficult to detect but dangerous use-after-free bug.

The problem is `nodes[p_new_name] = nodes[p_name]` is equivalent to
`operator=(operator[](nodes, p_new_name), operator[](const nodes, p_name))`

which means that both operator[] will be evaluated, in an arbitrary order before the operator= runs. One of the operator[] calls will invalidate the const reference returned by the other.

Since Node is a struct, it is safe to make a copy, and then store it, so this fix is correct.
